name: Feast
description: Open-source feature store for machine learning. Defines manages and serves features consistently across offline training and online inference. Supports Redis DynamoDB BigQuery and Snowflake backends.
best_for: Real-time feature serving, training-serving consistency, feature reuse
pricing_notes: Free and open-source; Tecton provides managed enterprise feature platform
tags: feast feature-store open-source serving training consistency redis bigquery

name: Tecton
description: Enterprise feature platform for operationalizing ML features at production scale. Provides feature pipelines feature serving (millisecond latency) feature sharing and monitoring with 99.99% uptime SLA.
best_for: Production feature serving at scale, real-time ML, enterprise SLA guarantees
tags: tecton enterprise feature-platform real-time serving monitoring sla ml-production

name: Hopsworks
description: Open-source data platform with feature store for ML. Provides feature groups feature pipelines and feature serving with integration to PyTorch TensorFlow and scikit-learn training workflows.
best_for: Feature engineering at scale, training data versioning, on-premise feature stores
pricing_notes: Community edition free; Enterprise contact for pricing
tags: hopsworks feature-store platform open-source versioning training serving on-premise

name: Vertex AI Feature Store
description: Google Cloud's managed feature store for sharing reusing and serving ML features at low latency. Provides online and batch serving with integration to BigQuery and Vertex AI training pipelines.
best_for: GCP-native feature serving, Vertex AI integration, managed feature management
pricing_notes: Per node-hour + storage costs; varies by tier
tags: vertex-feature-store gcp managed feature-serving bigquery online-batch

name: SageMaker Feature Store
description: AWS SageMaker's managed feature store for storing retrieving and sharing ML features. Supports online store for low-latency serving and offline store in S3 for batch training.
best_for: AWS-native feature management, SageMaker pipeline integration, online+offline serving
pricing_notes: Online: $0.25/1M reads; Offline: S3 costs; Contact for enterprise
tags: sagemaker feature-store aws managed online offline serving s3

name: Featureform
description: Virtual feature store that works as a meta-layer on top of existing data infrastructure. Allows data scientists to define features declaratively without moving data by leveraging existing Spark Snowflake and Redis.
best_for: Metadata-driven feature management, existing infra reuse, small-to-mid teams
tags: featureform virtual feature-store declarative metadata infra-reuse snowflake spark redis

name: TSFresh
description: Python package for automatic extraction of relevant features from time series data. Calculates 787 time series features and selects the most statistically significant ones using hypothesis testing.
best_for: Automated time-series feature extraction, IoT sensor data, predictive maintenance
tags: tsfresh time-series feature-extraction automated hypothesis-testing iot maintenance

name: Featuretools
description: Open-source framework for automated feature engineering. Synthesizes new features from relational data using Deep Feature Synthesis (DFS) algorithm to automatically create hundreds of relevant features.
best_for: Automated feature engineering for relational data, fraud detection, customer analytics
pricing_notes: Free OSS; Alteryx platform for enterprise
tags: featuretools automated feature-engineering dfs relational alteryx fraud customer
